title: LTO sets new renewal period for vehicle registrations, licenses that expired from July-Oct. 2026

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Land Transportation Office (LTO) has implemented new renewal periods until February 2027 for motor vehicle registrations, driver’s licenses, and other permits that expired from July to October this year. In an advisory on Tuesday, the LTO said that this new implementation is under the Memorandum Circular (MC) No. MVL-2026-5523, which lifted the extended validity previously granted under MC No. MVL-5271.
